title: 20.6s Recording (Jun 15 @ 6:48 PM)
style: Latin pop ballad featuring a solo male tenor vocal. The arrangement is centered around a nylon-string acoustic guitar playing a rhythmic fingerstyle pattern with percussive slaps on the strings. A subtle, warm synth pad provides harmonic support in the background. The vocal performance is intimate with a slight natural vibrato and is processed with a short room reverb. The tempo is 92 BPM in the key of G major.
